title: Vibrant Citrusy Greek Sausages Saganaki
description: A citrusy and gooey one-pot Greek dish featuring kabanos sausages, this saganaki is perfect for a weeknight dinner, and it is Whole30 friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced kabanos sausages and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausages from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lemon juice, orange zest, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the cooked sausages to the skillet and stir to coat with the citrus mixture.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer the saganaki for 5 minutes.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
